name: QR Scanner & Maker: Quadwick
subtitle: Scan, Create & Print QR Codes
shortDescription: Scan, create and print QR codes and barcodes. Safe link check, Wi-Fi, vCard.
longDescription:
QR code generator and scanner in one fast, private app. Scan QR codes and barcodes with the camera or from a picture; links get a safety check before they open; add contacts, calendar events, call, text, email or open a location in one tap; payment codes show a preview only.

### Create
QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, contacts (vCard), email, SMS, phone, location, events, social profiles, app-store links and menu links, plus Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A and Code 39 barcodes.

### Style and Print
Colours, rounded modules, a centre logo and a "Scan me" frame, and a live "will it scan" meter that checks contrast, size and quiet zone. Export PNG, SVG and print-ready PDF.

Scanning and basic black and white codes are free. Styled and high-resolution exports use credits you earn by watching a short ad, or go ad-free with the monthly plan. No account. Everything stays on your device.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
